name: chrono-shi-xu
description: 时序 Chrono · 本地优先的个人时间调度

scripts.test: node tests/engine.test.js && node tests/ui-smoke.js && node tests/llm.test.js && node tests/sync.test.js && node tests/holiday.test.js && node tests/routine.test.js && node tests/agent.test.js && node tests/lock.test.js && node tests/overlap.test.js && node tests/pair.test.js && node tests/longterm.test.js && node tests/cloud.test.js && node tests/remote.test.js
scripts.ios:add: npm i @capacitor/core @capacitor/cli @capacitor/ios @capacitor/local-notifications && npx cap add ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run www && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.android:add: npm i @capacitor/android && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run www && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.desktop: cd desktop && npm install && npm run dist
